news.title: Rubio explains how U.S. might 'run' Venezuela after Maduros' ouster
news.description: President Donald Trump on Saturday said the U.S. will "run" Venezuela until a new leader is determined.

news.title: Maduro overthrow in oil-rich Venezuela unlikely to shake energy markets in the near term
news.description: While Venezuela has the world's largest oil reserves, its oil production is relatively small.

news.title: Trump's removal of Maduro prompts questions from Congress
news.description: Congressional lawmakers say they were not briefed before President Donald Trump launched a land attack on Venezuela and deposed President Nicolas Maduro.
